chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), when he married Maymunah bint al-Harith, hosted a feast for her and fed the people al-hays.

key_terms.أَوْلَمَ: To host a wedding feast or celebration
key_terms.الْحَيْسَ: A traditional dish made from barley, yogurt, and vinegar, often cited in hadith regarding prophetic dietary practices
key_terms.مَيْمُونَةَ: Maymunah bint al-Harith, a wife of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad do to celebrate his marriage to Maymunah bint al-Harith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) in celebrating marriage through communal feasting, specifically noting his provision of 'al-hays' (a date and barley porridge) to the community. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on modest yet generous social rituals that strengthen communal bonds during the transition of marital status.
